description: Jakarta WebSocket Client API provides the standard client-side API for opening and interacting with WebSocket connections from Jakarta and Java applications. It defines annotations and interfaces for endpoints, sessions, message handling, encoders, decoders, and container access while leaving the runtime implementation to a compatible WebSocket provider.
